description: A stylized, anthropomorphic desk lamp with a bulbous, light pink head and two small red eyes. It stands on a pale yellow cylindrical base, supported by two light blue, U-shaped arms that connect to the base. A thin, cream-colored cord extends from the back of the lamp head and curves down to the base, creating a playful, almost creature-like appearance. The design is minimalist and modern, with smooth curves and simple shapes.
